report_identity.report_title: San Miguel Brewery Hong Kong Ltd. Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and distributes bottled, canned and draught beers, with Hong Kong operations also leasing investment properties.

segments.name: Hong Kong
segments.business_substance: beer manufacturing/distribution, imported beer distribution and investment property leasing

segments.name: Mainland China
segments.business_substance: beer manufacturing and distribution in Southern China and overseas

business_overview.revenue_model: Invoiced value of beer products sold, net of discounts, returns, VAT and consumption tax; investment property rental is recorded in other net income.
business_notes: Largest customer contributed 57.69% of 2025 sales per directors' report.
2025 Hong Kong domestic beer market volumes declined 3%; company local sales also declined 3%, while export growth lifted Hong Kong total sales volumes by 11%.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow stayed positive and covered reported/normalized profit. Median free cash flow after PPE capex was HKD64.203m, lower than the 2025 parent profit, so the owner-earnback denominator uses the cash-flow-supported median before an additional business-quality haircut.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by legal entity, parent company versus subsidiaries, or by exact jurisdiction/maturity combination.
No explicit restricted cash line was found; Mainland China remittance limits are disclosed but not described as legally restricted cash.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not separately disclosed, so PPE purchase cash outflow is used conservatively as maintenance capex proxy.
